//: A task runner, nothing more. Stash is a Python project and this file has no
dependencies -- `npm install` is never needed, only `npm run <script>`.
There is deliberately NO `version` field. The version lives in
stashlib/_version.py and nowhere else; a copy here would be one more thing
that can disagree with the git tag. `npm run ver` reads the real one.
Scripts split by interpreter on purpose:
python.exe  -- Windows Python. Anything touching Qt, the GUI, or the build.
A WSL interpreter cannot host the panel: the drag into
Resolve is a native Windows CF_HDROP.
python3     -- WSL. Version, changelog and release plumbing, which is pure
stdlib plus git and has no reason to cross the boundary.
`npm run` with no arguments lists everything below.
name: stash
description: Searchable media library that drags into DaVinci Resolve

scripts.test: python3 -m compileall -q panel stashlib scripts && python3 -m stashlib.normalize
